title: Database cleanup switches running mode to "Disabled Loop" [3.4.*]
body:
This morning two of my AAPS installations switched to "disabled loop" without any reason (https://www.facebook.com/groups/1900195340201874/?multi_permalinks=4561724530715595).

Claude investigation shows that it's related to the DB cleanup process which removes the current "running state" entry making it fallback to "disable loop"

The Claude discussion is available here: https://claude.ai/share/37f95b8e-6b43-42b6-8a20-d5a5fe5a728a

Couldn't verify on my own but it looks plausible.

comments.body: that's exactly the wrong use of AI. ask to find an issue and it will find one

So I wake up to both my kids loop disabled somewhere during the night, but because logs contain only last hour, there is no problem?

Was the AI investigation wrong or you just don't like it general?
